image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of the dorsal side of a large whale swimming in green water. The skin is dark grey with significant mottling and white patches consistent with barnacle encrustation. A distinct longitudinal ridge runs along the back. A yellow object (likely part of a kayak or boat) is visible in the bottom left corner.
